claim: The cited analysis reports that the number of global data centres in high water-stress areas grew from about 200 in 1995 to about 3,300 in 2025.
comparisonContext: This is a stronger public-facing way to explain why regional siting matters more than a single per-prompt anecdote.
scopeNote: Global site-count framing from reported analysis, not a direct measure of water withdrawals.
sourceTitle: AI Is Draining Water From Areas That Need It Most
